name: Tide Pool

steps.script: project.groups.gSeconds='Seconds trace'; for(const e of project.elements) if(e.name.startsWith('Tide segment')||['Tide marker','Seconds tens','Seconds ones'].includes(e.name)) e.group='gSeconds';

description: An Open Sans clock over a bathymetric map. A clockwise seconds trace starts at twelve o’clock and carries its seconds label.
